item.title: Appium & Mobile Testing Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics)

  1. What is Appium?
  2. What are the types of mobile applications?
  3. What is mobile testing?
  4. Which tools do you use for mobile testing?
  5. What are the versions you are testing currently in Android and iOS?
  6. What is the Android version of the mobile you have tested?
  7. What are the applications you have tested in mobile?

Questions with Answers

1. What is Appium?

Answer: Appium is an open-source, cross-platform test automation tool used for mobile applications (iOS, Android). It allows you to write tests against multiple platforms using the same API.
